originality.rationale: With physical x=ξ, center manifold y=ξ+Aξ³+Bξ⁵, z=Cξ²+Dξ⁴ yields C=1/β, A=-1/[β(σ+1)], D=-(β-2σ)/[β³(σ+1)], B=-(2βσ-β+2σ²+2σ)/[β³(σ+1)³]. Independently substituted these into BOTH invariance equations and checked all determining coefficients vanish symbolically for general positive σ,β (not just test values). Then ξ′=-cξ³+qξ⁵+O(ξ⁷), c=σ/[β(σ+1)]>0, q=σB; W=ξ^-2 obeys W′=2c-2q/W+O(W^-2), giving W=2ct-(q/c)log(t)+C+o(1), since final error O(log t/t²) is integrable. Exact rational standard parameters give 2c=15/22 and -q/c=609/1936. Scope local nonzero center-manifold trajectories only.
